name: markwork
description: Markdown workspace for humans and AI agents
author: Eka Putra <eka@ekaput.com>

scripts.typecheck: tsc --noEmit && tsc --noEmit -p tsconfig.node.json && tsc --noEmit -p tsconfig.electron.json && node scripts/layers.mjs && node scripts/ui.mjs
scripts.test: npm run test:git-rules && npm run test:site && npm run test:core:node && npm run test:electron
scripts.test:core:node: tsc --noEmit -p tsconfig.node.json && node scripts/layers.mjs && node scripts/ui.mjs && vite build -c vite.node.config.ts && node dist-node/run-core-node.js
scripts.test:electron: npm run electron:build && xvfb-run -a -s '-screen 0 1280x800x24' npm run test:electron:run
scripts.test:electron:run: node tests/electron/startup.mjs && node tests/electron/smoke.mjs && node tests/electron/editor.mjs && node tests/electron/visual.mjs && node tests/electron/panes.mjs && node tests/electron/sidebar.mjs && node tests/electron/robust.mjs && node tests/electron/structured.mjs && node tests/electron/layout.mjs && node tests/electron/assistant.mjs && node tests/electron/git.mjs && node tests/electron/harness.mjs && node tests/electron/programs.mjs && node tests/electron/secrets.mjs && node tests/electron/inspector.mjs && node tests/electron/ui-gallery.mjs && node tests/electron/repros.mjs
scripts.test:live:forge: vite build -c vite.node.config.ts && set -a && { [ ! -f ./.env ] || . ./.env; } && set +a && node dist-node/live-forge.js
scripts.test:live: vite build -c vite.node.config.ts && set -a && . ./.env && set +a && node dist-node/live.js
scripts.docs: npm run site:build && npm run electron:build && node scripts/capture.mjs
